services.organizationName: New Castle County Department of Community Services - Housing Authority - Housing Choice Vouchers
services.servicesDescription: Housing Choice Vouchers can be used either in public housing units that are operated and maintained by the Public Housing Authority or made available for low-income households to use toward rental assistance in the community. Eligibility includes those with disabilities and elderly persons whose income does not exceed 80% of the local median income. Voucher holders must locate their own unit. The voucher holder pays a portion of the rent each month and the voucher pays the remaining portion. The amount of assistance paid is determined by several factors including income, amount of rent being requested, utilities the renter is responsible for, and the size of the family. Housing Choice Vouchers are transferrable to other units including to another Public Housing Authority jurisdiction. Each Public Housing Authority (PHA) has their own application process and their own way of prioritizing their waitlist. Waitlists are often only open during certain times of the year and applications can only be accepted during those "open" times. It is essential for applicants on a waitlist to keep their contact information and current mailing address updated so they can respond when contacted by a PHA. The New Castle County Dept. of Community Services has a total of 1,825 Vouchers.
